# ARTEL

> ARTEL is a game QA tool. Add the SDK to a Unity game and an AI agent plays it directly, checks test cases, and keeps evidence (screenshots, logs, the step timeline) at the moment a failure happens. You can use the hosted service or self-host it.

Unity 게임에 SDK를 연결하면 에이전트가 직접 플레이하며 테스트 케이스를 검증하고 실패 순간의 증거를 남기는 게임 QA 도구

## Pages

- [Implement cheats](https://artel.kr/en/docs/cheats): C# registration, preconditions, parameters, invocation and troubleshooting
- [Implement behaviors](https://artel.kr/en/docs/behaviors): ongoing game actions, lifecycle, progress and cleanup

- [Home](https://artel.kr/en): what ARTEL does and who it is for
- [SDK](https://artel.kr/en/sdk): install the Unity SDK and connect a game
- [CLI](https://artel.kr/en/cli): install the ARTEL CLI and run QA from a terminal or CI
- [CLI install instructions for AI agents](https://artel.kr/cli.md): plain-text guide an AI coding agent follows to install the ARTEL CLI
- [Agent skills](https://artel.kr/en/skills): skills that teach an AI coding agent to use ARTEL (Unity SDK setup, CLI, local MCP server, game cheats and behaviors). Install with `npx skills add project-artel/artel-skills`
- [Skills install instructions for AI agents](https://artel.kr/skills.md): plain-text guide an AI coding agent follows to install the ARTEL skills
- [Self-hosting](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting): run ARTEL on your own machine
- [Self-hosting: Install script](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting/install-script): install ARTEL with one command
- [Self-hosting: Docker Compose](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting/docker-compose): run ARTEL with Docker Compose
- [Self-hosting: Desktop app](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting/desktop-app): install ARTEL as a desktop app (planned)

- [Macro quick start: write, register and run a macro](https://artel.kr/en/macro)
- [Macro language: types, conditions, loops and imports](https://artel.kr/en/macro/language)
- [Macro built-ins: lookup, reader and action signatures](https://artel.kr/en/macro/built-ins)
- [Macro execution: checks, waits, checkpoints and model decisions](https://artel.kr/en/macro/execution)
- [Macro limits and errors: budgets and troubleshooting](https://artel.kr/en/macro/limits)

- [Developer documentation](https://artel.kr/en/docs): ARTEL developer guide
- [Installation](https://artel.kr/en/docs/installation): ARTEL developer guide
- [Authentication and CLI tokens](https://artel.kr/en/docs/authentication): ARTEL developer guide
- [Models and LLM APIs](https://artel.kr/en/docs/models): ARTEL developer guide
- [Run QA](https://artel.kr/en/docs/qa): ARTEL developer guide
- [GitHub Actions](https://artel.kr/en/docs/github-actions): ARTEL developer guide
- [Architecture](https://artel.kr/en/docs/architecture): ARTEL developer guide
- [GitHub contribution](https://artel.kr/en/docs/contributing): ARTEL developer guide
